title: Aa Rahi Hai Ye Sada
body:
aa rahi hai ye sada zainab e dilgeer ki
laash be gor-o-kafan hai dasht mein shabbir ki
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
ab nahi abbas-e-ghazi qasim-o-akbar kahan
haaye ab koi uthaye laash be-takseer ki
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
jiska maatha choom ke is dil ko milta tha karaar
aaj us shabbir ke gardan pe hai khanjar ki dhaar
haye wo cheh maah ka bacha tadapta reh gaya
maa kaleja thaam ke rone lagi hai zaar zaar
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
kardiya quran zaqmi hurmala ke teer ne
jante na thay muasalman azmate baysheer ki
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
aagayi ummat nabi ki aag lekar haat mein
laaj rakh lena khudaya chadare tatheer ki
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein is tarha se ghar luta shabbir ka
zulm ki badli mein parda kho gaya hamsheer ka
ek teer hurmala se zakhm hai kitne azaa ke
maa ka dil sarwar ka baazu aur gala baysheer ka
aa rahi hai ye....
<<DIVIDER>>
sar diya gulzaar jab islam par shabbir ne
khoon ke khatron ne phir khake shafa akseer ki
aa rahi hai ye....
author: Gulzaar Jafri
